item.title: Dylan Guenther power play goal breaks tie as Seattle Kraken lose 5-3 to Mammoth
item.description: Dylan Guenther scored a go-ahead power-play goal in the third period and the Utah Mammoth beat the Seattle Kraken 5-3 on Friday night.

item.title: Washington men's soccer reaches national championship with 3-1 win over Furman
item.description: The University of Washington men's soccer team earned a trip to the College Cup final with a 3-1 victory over Furman University on Friday night.

item.title: Skagit River flooded homes in Burlington, WA, residents still evacuated Friday
item.description: As the Skagit River crested at historic heights, the entire town of Burlington was evacuated. Residents talked with FOX 13 about their flooded homes and conditions they saw on roadways.

item.title: LIVE UPDATES: WA flooding dies down, slides and road closures remain
item.description: While the worst of the flooding is over and the atmospheric river drying out, communities in western Washington are now left with a long cleanup ahead of them.

item.title: Chelan County officials issue evacuation order for Stehekin Valley, WA
item.description: Residents in the Stehekin Valley have been ordered to evacuate ahead of incoming heavy rain threatening already fragile slide areas.

item.title: Rainy weather returns to soaked Seattle on Sunday
item.description: River levels will recede today, but another round of river flooding is a possibility during the workweek. Right now, next week's flooding doesn't look as intense as this week's, but there will still be dangers and impacts.

item.title: Gov. Ferguson, WA senators tour Mount Vernon’s flood wall after atmospheric river
item.description: Thousands evacuated, homes destroyed, and damage scattered across western Washington. It has been a heartbreaking and grueling week for so many.

item.title: Colts promote Philip Rivers to active roster ahead of matchup with Seattle Seahawks
item.description: The Indianapolis Colts promoted 44-year-old quarterback Philip Rivers to the active roster Saturday, making him eligible to play — and perhaps start — in Sunday's crucial game at Seattle.

item.title: Seattle Weather: Light Showers on Sunday
item.description: We got a much-needed break from the rain on Saturday and got to enjoy a beautiful sunset. Rivers are still running very high with many road closures still in effect.

item.title: Washington rolls to 38-10 victory over Boise State in LA Bowl
item.description: Demond Williams Jr. threw three four touchdown passes, and Washington's defense had five interceptions as the Huskies kicked off bowl season with a 38-10 victory over Boise State in the LA Bowl.
